subject: Graph over-writes Y axis guides when axis.text.y is specified

messages.author: 519455d3bf64680d
messages.subject: Graph over-writes Y axis guides when axis.text.y is specified
parts:
Consider:

ggplot(data=diamonds)+geom_boxplot(aes(x=cut, y=price))+
opts(
axis.text.x= theme_text(size=30),
axis.text.y= theme_text(size=30),
axis.title.x= theme_text(size=30),
plot.title= theme_text(size=60),
axis.title.y= theme_text(size=30, angle=90),
strip.text.x = theme_text(size=30),
strip.text.y = theme_text(size=30, angle=90),
legend.text = theme_text(size=30),
legend.title = theme_text(size=35)
)

on my machine, the Y axis (price) guides are over-laid by the actual
graph itself, leading to truncated Y axis guides. So, I see "100" when I
want to see "1000", etc. The problem gets worse as you increase size
for axis.text.y. The problem disappears when size for axis.text.y is
not specified. The behaviour persists when output is redirected to
various Cairo and non-Cairo devices. Can other replicate this?

R version 2.11.0 (2010-04-22)
x86_64-pc-linux-gnu
